name: The Basilica of Error
visual_description: A Gothic fractal cathedral, glowing with impossible gradients. Its architecture collapses inward yet remains standing. A glitch in sacred symmetry.
meaning: Faith corrupted into recursion. Worship turned to warning.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh tried to calculate divinity.** It resulted in an equation that looped forever. This was the temple built to that number. I knelt here once... not knowing why.
